boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Towson University
boards.description: Ten currently documented food and convenience stops with evening or overnight availability in Towson and on campus.

cards.title: Tiger Express
cards.subtitle: West Village Commons, Towson University
cards.notes: Use the autonomous market in West Village Commons when other campus dining counters have closed; bring an accepted payment method for purchases.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 on-campus convenience option for packaged meals, snacks, drinks and essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson University identifies Tiger Express in West Village Commons as a 24/7 autonomous convenience store with quick meals, drinks and snacks.
cards.access_notes: Official TU page states Tiger Express is open 24/7; it is an autonomous store in West Village Commons.

cards.title: The Den @ PAWS
cards.subtitle: University Union, first floor
cards.notes: Check the day before heading over: the campus dining page lists service through 11:30 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.short_summary: A University Union Denny's-branded counter with late evening service on select days.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson Dining lists The Den @ PAWS in the University Union with standard hours until 11:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed standard hours are until 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 11:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Loch Raven Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 6861 Loch Raven Blvd, Towson
cards.notes: For the latest window, use the drive-thru or delivery option; the official listing shows drive-thru service as late as 4 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Towson Taco Bell whose official listing documents overnight drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Towson listing shows drive-thru hours until 4:00 a.m. on Wednesday through Monday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Towson, MD - 6861 Loch Raven Blvd
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows drive-thru until 4:00 a.m. Wednesday–Monday; verify the day’s schedule before going.

cards.title: 2AM Project
cards.subtitle: 416 York Rd, Towson
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order through the restaurant's ordering page, which currently lists orders accepted until 1:40 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A York Road food stop with officially posted online ordering into early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: 2AM Project's official ordering page lists its 416 York Road Towson location and online ordering hours of 11:45 a.m. to 1:40 a.m.
cards.source_title: 2AM Project 416 York Rd – Order pickup and delivery
cards.access_notes: The restaurant's ordering page currently lists pickup and delivery ordering until 1:40 a.m.; availability may change.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on York Road
cards.subtitle: 321 York Rd, Towson
cards.notes: Use this York Road convenience stop for hot foods, bakery items or packaged snacks when you need an overnight purchase option.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store on York Road with hot-food and coffee features listed.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven's official page for 321 York Road in Towson states that the store is open 24/7 and lists Hot Foods and Specialty Coffee + Fresh Bakery.
cards.access_notes: The official store page states “Open 24/7.”

cards.title: Underground Pizza Company
cards.subtitle: 28 Allegheny Ave, Unit 3, Towson
cards.notes: Plan Friday or Saturday pickup for the latest listed hours, and allow for the stated 30-minute kitchen-close buffer before closing.
cards.short_summary: A Towson pizza counter with 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday restaurant hours posted directly.
cards.evidence_claim: Underground Pizza Company's official site lists its Towson location at 28 Allegheny Avenue and Friday and Saturday hours until 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Underground Pizza CO. – Detroit Style Pizza
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours until 11 p.m.; it says the kitchen closes 30 minutes before the restaurant.

cards.title: MOD Pizza Towson Station
cards.subtitle: 740 York Rd, Suite 105, Towson
cards.notes: For a later dinner window, target Thursday through Saturday, when the location's official page lists closing at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A York Road pizza restaurant with late evening hours on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: MOD Pizza's official Towson Station page lists Thursday, Friday and Saturday hours from 10:30 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows service until 11:00 p.m. Thursday–Saturday; other days are listed until 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Seasons Pizza
cards.subtitle: 40 York Rd, Towson
cards.notes: Schedule a Friday or Saturday pickup if you need the latest listed window; the store page posts 11 p.m. closing on both nights.
cards.short_summary: A York Road pizza shop whose own store page posts 11 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Seasons Pizza's official Towson store page lists hours until 11:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official store hours list 11:00 p.m. closings Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Papa Johns on York Road
cards.subtitle: 201 York Rd, Towson
cards.notes: Order delivery or carryout earlier in the evening; the official schedule extends delivery to midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.short_summary: A York Road pizza location with midnight weekend delivery listed by the business.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns' official page for 201 York Road in Towson lists delivery hours until 12:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns York Rd | Papa Johns Towson, MD
cards.access_notes: Official delivery hours run until midnight Friday–Saturday; carryout is listed until 11:40 p.m. on those nights.

cards.title: Domino's on Loch Raven Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 8010 Loch Raven Blvd, Towson
cards.notes: Use the official store page to confirm the current closing time before ordering; it currently identifies this Towson location as open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Loch Raven Boulevard pizza store whose official page currently shows a midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official location page identifies the Towson store at 8010 Loch Raven Boulevard and states it is open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 8010 Loch Raven Blvd | Domino's in Towson
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently displays “Today Until 12:00 AM”; check it again for the applicable day.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named Towson campus spaces for collaborating, focused work, creative projects and community use.

cards.title: Set up in the Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, third floor
cards.notes: Bring a laptop for solo work or a small-group session; use the writable glass tables and shared displays, then keep the room considerate for others.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 library lounge that supports both private-pod studying and small-group collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library says the Study Lounge is available any time, with private study pods, writable glass tables and large displays for group screen sharing.
cards.source_title: Study Lounge | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Available any time; a valid TU ID is required after the library closes.

cards.title: Claim a group-study setup
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, second floor
cards.notes: Reserve an eligible room ahead or use an open space; arrange the movable furnishings, share a screen and use the glass whiteboards for project planning.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative rooms and cubicles configured for teams, conferencing and shared computer work.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library identifies second-floor group study areas with group computers, configurable furnishings, glass whiteboards and rooms that may be reservable or first-come.
cards.source_title: Group Study and Collaborative Areas | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Some rooms are reservable; otherwise use is first-come, first-served when open and unreserved.

cards.title: Rehearse in the Presentation Practice Room
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, CK212
cards.notes: Book CK212 when available and run through slides with your group; use the room’s display, camera, microphone and whiteboards to tighten a presentation.
cards.short_summary: A reservable practice room equipped for screen sharing and recorded presentation rehearsal.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists CK212 with a collaborative display, ceiling-mounted camera and microphone, whiteboards and seating for up to 10; group work has priority.
cards.source_title: Group Study and Collaborative Areas | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Reservations are available for the listed room; otherwise it is first-come, first-served. Solo users must yield to groups.

cards.title: Work with maps in the Data Studio
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use a Data Studio workstation for a mapping, visualization or analysis task; save files to your own storage and check available software before starting.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library workstation area for GIS, mapping, data analysis and visualization.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists five Data Studio computers with data-analysis and GIS mapping software, including ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, R, Tableau and Power BI.
cards.source_title: Computers in the Library | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Located on Cook Library’s second floor; consult library technology information for current workstation availability.

cards.title: Meet in the Graduate Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, CK211
cards.notes: Graduate students can bring a collaborator or spread out at a large table; swipe a OneCard for entry and use the screen for a presentation run-through.
cards.short_summary: A graduate-only room combining quiet study, group tables, computers and presentation space.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library describes CK211 as graduate-student-only, accessed by OneCard, with 10 Windows computers, large group-work tables and a presentation-practice monitor.
cards.source_title: Group Study and Collaborative Areas | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Reserved for graduate students only; use a TU OneCard for access.

cards.title: Choose CK200C for silence
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use this room when an assignment needs uninterrupted focus; arrive ready to work quietly and choose another library space if you need to discuss a project.
cards.short_summary: A named library room designated for individual quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library’s student guide says individuals can study in absolute quiet in room CK200C on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Things Every Student Should Know about Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Intended for quiet individual study; see the library building directory for current access information.

cards.title: Take a pause in the Interfaith Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, room 401
cards.notes: Head to room 401 when you need a reflective break between classes; keep the shared setting calm and follow any posted room guidance.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed fourth-floor space for quiet reflection within Cook Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library’s building directory lists the Interfaith Meditation Room as room 401 on the fourth floor.
cards.source_title: Building Directory | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Located on Cook Library’s fourth floor; check building access and posted room guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Browse TU history in Special Collections
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, room 505
cards.notes: Plan a visit to room 505 to explore historic university materials; contact the department ahead if you need in-depth research help with its collections.
cards.short_summary: The library’s archive destination for rare materials, historic photos, yearbooks and university records.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists Special Collections and University Archives in room 505, and its student guide says it connects students with historic photos, yearbooks, newspapers and course catalogs.
cards.source_title: Building Directory | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Guests are welcome during department open hours; contact Special Collections in advance for in-depth research assistance.

cards.title: Use the University Union as a meetup point
cards.subtitle: Towson University campus
cards.notes: Use the Union to meet classmates before an activity or appointment, then check the relevant office’s current hours if you need a particular service.
cards.short_summary: Towson’s central co-curricular building for student services, programs and informal interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson describes the University Union as the hub of co-curricular activities and programs, where students can relax, interact and share interests and experiences.
cards.access_notes: Union and office hours vary during events and academic breaks; verify the office or building schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Find open recreation at Burdick Turf Fields
cards.subtitle: Near the University Union Parking Garage
cards.notes: Check whether the fields are unreserved, then use the marked space for casual recreation with friends; yield to scheduled Campus Recreation programming or reservations.
cards.short_summary: A large, multi-sport field complex usable for open recreation when it is not reserved.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson says the 200,000-square-foot Burdick Turf Fields support recreation and are accessible for open recreation when not reserved.
cards.access_notes: Open recreation is available only when fields are not reserved; entrances are near the University Union Parking Garage and bridge corners.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-cost ways for TU students to spend time together on campus, with access details checked against Towson’s public pages.

cards.entity_name: Rock climbing at the Campus Recreation Center
cards.title: Climb together at Burdick Hall
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center, Burdick Hall
cards.notes: Bring a friend to the climbing wall and choose routes that fit your comfort level; climbing equipment is available to use.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost climbing session with equipment provided.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson says eligible TU students, faculty and staff have free access to Campus Recreation Center facilities, including the climbing wall and free climbing equipment.
cards.access_notes: Free access is for TU students, faculty and staff; the Campus Recreation Center is in Burdick Hall.

cards.entity_name: Group fitness classes at the Campus Recreation Center
cards.title: Join a group fitness class
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center, Burdick Hall
cards.notes: Pick a daily class such as yoga, cycling, Zumba, HIIT, boxing, or total-body strength and attend with a classmate.
cards.short_summary: Scheduled movement classes without a separate fee for eligible TU users.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson lists group fitness and yoga classes as free and offered daily, and states eligible TU students, faculty and staff have free Campus Recreation Center access.
cards.access_notes: Free access is for TU students, faculty and staff; check the TU Campus Rec app for the current class schedule.

cards.entity_name: Pick-up basketball at the Campus Recreation Center
cards.title: Shoot around or join a pick-up game
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center, Burdick Hall
cards.notes: Meet at the basketball hoops for a low-planning game, then borrow what you need from the equipment checkout room.
cards.short_summary: Court time and basketball equipment are included with eligible access.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson identifies basketball hoops for pick-up games and says eligible TU students, faculty and staff have free Campus Recreation Center access and equipment checkout.
cards.access_notes: Free access is for TU students, faculty and staff; basketballs are among the items available through equipment checkout.

cards.entity_name: Lap swimming at the Campus Recreation Center
cards.title: Take a swim break
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center, Burdick Hall
cards.notes: Plan a relaxed pool session with a friend or use separate lanes for an easy shared workout between classes.
cards.short_summary: Use the lap pool with eligible Campus Recreation access.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson lists a lap swimming pool among Campus Recreation Center facilities and says TU students, faculty and staff have free access to those facilities.
cards.access_notes: Free access is for TU students, faculty and staff; confirm open-swim availability in the TU Campus Rec app.

cards.entity_name: Badminton or table tennis at the Campus Recreation Center
cards.title: Set up a racquet-game session
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center, Burdick Hall
cards.notes: Choose badminton or table tennis for a quick two-person activity, using the center’s courts and checkout equipment.
cards.short_summary: A casual indoor game using included courts and gear.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson lists badminton and table tennis among Campus Recreation Center court activities and says eligible TU users have free facility access and equipment checkout.
cards.access_notes: Free access is for TU students, faculty and staff; badminton racquets are listed among equipment checkout items.

cards.entity_name: Open training at the Campus Recreation Center
cards.title: Try the turf training area
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center, Burdick Hall
cards.notes: Use the open turf area for a self-paced session with sleds, boxes, stadium stairs, or the sprint hill alongside a friend.
cards.short_summary: A flexible no-cost workout area for eligible TU users.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson lists an open training area with turf, sleds, boxes, stadium stairs and a sprint hill, and states eligible TU users have free facility access.
cards.access_notes: Free access is for TU students, faculty and staff; use equipment responsibly and follow posted facility guidance.

cards.title: Drop into an Intramural Free Event
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Intramural Sports, Burdick Hall
cards.notes: Watch the Intramural schedule for informal Meet & Play, adaptive recreation, or welcome activities where you can join without a league pass.
cards.short_summary: Informal campus recreation events designed for active social time.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson states that an Intramural Sports Pass is not required for its Free Events, which include informal activities such as Meet & Play Events and Adaptive Recreation.
cards.access_notes: Free Events are separate from pass-required seasons and tournaments; consult the current Intramural schedule for offerings.

cards.title: See the Holtzman MFA Gallery
cards.subtitle: Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Visit during posted public hours to look through the current exhibition, then use the gallery as a starting point for a conversation.
cards.short_summary: A public campus gallery with free exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson states that all Holtzman MFA Gallery exhibitions are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The gallery posts current exhibition dates and public hours on its official page; verify before traveling.

cards.entity_name: Free scanning at Albert S. Cook Library
cards.title: Scan a shared find at Cook Library
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, main floor
cards.notes: Bring a photo, article, or class material to the main-floor scanners and send a digital copy to email or a USB drive.
cards.short_summary: A practical library stop that does not require buying printing credit.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson states that visitors can scan to email or USB for free using the scanners on Cook Library’s main floor.
cards.source_title: For Guests | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Free scanning is available on the main floor; visit the help desk if assistance is needed.

cards.entity_name: Guest computer use at Albert S. Cook Library
cards.title: Use a public computer at Cook Library
cards.subtitle: Albert S. Cook Library, main floor
cards.notes: Set up a shared research or planning session on a public computer; visitors can request the current guest login at the help desk.
cards.short_summary: Public computer access in a central campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson states that visitors and guests can log in to Cook Library public computers using a guest account obtained at the help desk.
cards.source_title: For Guests | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Community guests may visit when the Ask Us Desk is open; ask the main-floor help desk for the current guest-account password.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, named study environments in Albert S. Cook Library, with documented locations, formats, and access details.

cards.title: Settle into the Absolute Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2, Room 211
cards.notes: Bring reading or deep-focus work to Room 211, identified by Cook Library as an Absolute Quiet Room; keep conversation and calls elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A specifically designated quiet room on Cook Library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library identifies the Absolute Quiet Room in Room 211 on the second floor as a quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Find Our Quiet Study Spaces! | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Located in Cook Library, Floor 2, Room 211; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Use the Third-Floor Zoom and Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, back of Floor 3
cards.notes: Choose a pod at the back of Floor 3 for a contained work session; the library lists these separately among its quiet study spaces.
cards.short_summary: Named pods positioned at the back of Cook Library’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists Zoom and Study Pods at the back of the third floor among its quiet study spaces.
cards.source_title: Find Our Quiet Study Spaces! | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: At the back of Cook Library’s third floor; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Work from a Study Lounge Pod
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 3 Academic Commons
cards.notes: Use a private study pod for solo work or a glass table and display for collaboration; bring a valid TU ID for after-hours access.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 library lounge with individual pods, group tables, displays, outlets and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study Lounge offers individual pods, glass tables, large displays, varied seating, outlets and printing; a valid TU ID is required after library closing.
cards.source_title: Study Lounge | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Available any time, day or week; valid TU ID is required after the library closes.

cards.title: Take a Fifth-Floor Perimeter Workstation
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 5
cards.notes: Head to the floor perimeter for a quiet-only workstation when your task needs sustained concentration rather than group discussion.
cards.short_summary: Quiet-only workstations arranged around the fifth-floor perimeter.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists quiet-study-only workstations around the perimeter of its fifth floor.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Quiet study only; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Claim a Fifth-Floor Study Cubicle
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, back of Floor 5
cards.notes: Use one of the first-come, first-served cubicles at the back of Floor 5 for an individual session with a defined personal workspace.
cards.short_summary: First-come, first-served cubicles on Cook Library’s fifth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists first-come-first-served cubicles at the back of its fifth floor.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Read in the Fourth-Floor Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, left side of Floor 4
cards.notes: Set up on the left side of Floor 4 for quiet study; the library also notes larger tables within the stacks and by the juvenile collection.
cards.short_summary: A library-designated quiet zone on the fourth floor near additional table seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library identifies the left side of the fourth floor as a Quiet Study Zone and lists quiet-preferred workstations and larger tables there.
cards.source_title: Find Our Quiet Study Spaces! | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the left side of Cook Library’s fourth floor; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Plan a Session in the Graduate Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2, Room 211
cards.notes: Use the Graduate Reading Room for a library-based work block; its named second-floor location is listed alongside other Cook study spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named graduate reading room on Cook Library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists a Graduate Reading Room among second-floor study spaces and identifies it as Room 211 in the building directory.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Second-floor study space; consult library hours and applicable room guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Focus in a Semi-Private Study Cubby
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2
cards.notes: Use a second-floor semi-private cubby when you want an individual setup without reserving a room; pair it with a library research task.
cards.short_summary: Individual semi-private cubbies listed among Cook Library’s second-floor study options.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists individual semi-private study cubbies on its second floor.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Second-floor space; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Reserve a Second-Floor Study Room
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2
cards.notes: Reserve a second-floor study room when your work needs a closed setting; use the library’s room-reservation link to check availability and requirements.
cards.short_summary: Bookable study rooms on Cook Library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists reservable study rooms on the second floor and provides a link to reserve a second-floor study room.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; use Cook Library’s reservation link to confirm availability and eligibility.

cards.title: Build Your Project in the Data Studio
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2
cards.notes: Choose the Data Studio for mapping, analysis or visualization work; it has individual and group stations dedicated to those project types.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor workspace with specialized stations for mapping, data analysis and visualization.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library’s Data Studio has four individual workstations and one group station supporting mapping, data analysis and data visualization projects.
cards.source_title: Albert S. Cook Library | Towson University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located on Cook Library’s second floor; consult library hours before visiting.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along York Road, Towsontown Boulevard, Dulaney Valley Road, and nearby downtown Towson corridors.

cards.title: Towson Row: mixed-use stop
cards.subtitle: York Road & Towsontown Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Start at the York Road and Towsontown Boulevard corner, then use the development directory to choose a specific retail, food, or service stop.
cards.short_summary: A named mixed-use destination at a campus-adjacent corner.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson Row identifies itself as being at the corner of York Road and Towsontown Boulevard and publishes a retail, dining, hotel, and wellness directory.
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own hours and access rules.

cards.title: Whole Foods: grocery pickup
cards.subtitle: Towson Row / York Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the store’s grocery-pickup option when you need to collect an order; confirm the current pickup details on the official store page before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Towson Row market with grocery pickup.
cards.evidence_claim: Whole Foods lists its Towson store at 300 Towson Row and identifies grocery pickup as a store service.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily store hours of 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; purchases are optional for entry but goods require payment.

cards.title: Raising Cane’s: walk-up window
cards.subtitle: West Towsontown Boulevard / York Road corridor
cards.notes: Choose the walk-up window for a quick order on the Towsontown Boulevard side of the York Road corridor; check the location page for service details.
cards.short_summary: A chicken-finger restaurant with a listed walk-up window.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its Towson location at 4 West Towsontown Boulevard and identifies a walk-up window among its features.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists dine-in hours through midnight daily; food purchases are required to order.

cards.title: The Charmery: handcrafted ice cream
cards.subtitle: York Road corridor
cards.notes: Visit the Towson shop at 6807 York Road for its handcrafted ice cream, and consult the official shop listing for the day’s current closing time.
cards.short_summary: A named York Road ice-cream shop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Charmery lists its Towson shop at 6807 York Road and describes its ice cream as handcrafted.
cards.access_notes: Official listing gives Towson hours of noon–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and noon–11 p.m. Friday–Sunday.

cards.entity_name: Baltimore County Public Library – Towson Branch
cards.title: Towson Library: public 3D printers
cards.subtitle: York Road corridor
cards.notes: Bring a project file or ask staff about the public 3D printers, then use a study room or quiet area for focused work during branch hours.
cards.short_summary: A public library branch with printing, study, and maker resources.
cards.evidence_claim: BCPL lists public 3D printers, study rooms, a quiet area, public computers, Wi-Fi, and programming at its Towson Branch at 320 York Road.
cards.access_notes: Branch hours are listed on the official page; some services, printing, or room reservations may have conditions or fees.

cards.title: Towson Town Center: indoor directory
cards.subtitle: Dulaney Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the center’s official directory to locate a store or food-court option before heading inside, especially when coordinating a multi-stop errand.
cards.short_summary: A named shopping center with an official store-and-restaurant directory.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson Town Center publishes a directory of stores and restaurants and lists its address as 825 Dulaney Valley Road.
cards.access_notes: Mall and tenant hours vary; check the official directory or individual tenant pages before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Round1 Bowling & Arcade – Towson Town Center
cards.title: Round1: bowling and arcade
cards.subtitle: Dulaney Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Plan a bowling, arcade, billiards, or karaoke session at the Towson Town Center location; review the venue’s current policies before a group visit.
cards.short_summary: A named indoor activity venue inside Towson Town Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Round1 lists bowling, arcade games, billiards, karaoke, party rooms, and Victory Zone at its Towson Town Center location.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 10 a.m.–2 a.m. daily; activities and food are paid offerings, and venue policies may apply.

cards.title: Cinemark: XD and D-BOX films
cards.subtitle: East Joppa Road / York Road corridor
cards.notes: Check showtimes and select an XD or D-BOX presentation if offered for your film; choose an age-appropriate title and follow the posted curfew policy.
cards.short_summary: A named movie theater with XD and D-BOX formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Cinemark identifies its Towson theater at 111 East Joppa Road and lists XD and D-BOX among its amenities.
cards.access_notes: Showtimes and age restrictions vary; the official page states that a weekend curfew applies to guests under 17 for showtimes after 5 p.m.

cards.title: Dulaney Plaza: everyday errands
cards.subtitle: Dulaney Valley Road corridor
cards.notes: Use this named center for a consolidated shopping or dining errand, and review its tenant information before traveling to a particular business.
cards.short_summary: A Towson shopping center near the Dulaney Valley Road retail corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Dulaney Plaza describes itself as a Towson shopping center off Dulaney Valley Road with shopping, dining, everyday necessities, and drive-up parking.
cards.access_notes: Tenant hours, availability, and purchase requirements vary by business.

cards.title: Shops at Kenilworth: retail loop
cards.subtitle: Kenilworth Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the center’s official site to identify a specific shop or service, then build a short errand loop around that named Kenilworth Drive destination.
cards.short_summary: A named Towson retail center on the Kenilworth corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shops at Kenilworth’s official site identifies the destination as a Towson shopping center.
cards.access_notes: Individual merchant hours and purchase requirements vary; confirm details with the destination or tenant before visiting.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented recurring Towson traditions, from campus-spirit rituals to signature celebrations and service events.

cards.title: Wear black and gold on Tuesday
cards.subtitle: Campuswide weekly pride tradition
cards.notes: Put on black and gold on a Tuesday, then check University Union programming for the related trivia, bingo and campus activities.
cards.short_summary: Towson’s weekly black-and-gold pride ritual pairs daytime spirit wear with evening activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson identifies Tiger TUesdays as a weekly tradition in which Tigers show school pride and participate in trivia and bingo.
cards.source_title: First month in photos | Towson University
cards.access_notes: The cited source places evening activities in the University Union; check TU events for a specific week’s details.

cards.title: Start the semester at Welcome to TU
cards.subtitle: Campuswide start-of-semester signature event
cards.notes: Use the opening days to learn campus routes, meet groups and attend scheduled activities; consult the current Welcome to TU program before arriving.
cards.short_summary: Welcome to TU is one of the university’s named, multi-day campuswide signature events.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson lists Welcome to TU among its campuswide Signature Events, described as annual multi-day celebrations.
cards.access_notes: Timing and locations shift by year; use the current TU events calendar for program details.

cards.title: Build up to the homecoming game
cards.subtitle: Campuswide traditional week of events
cards.notes: Follow the Homecoming schedule throughout the week, then join the school-pride events around the culminating football game if they fit your plans.
cards.short_summary: Towson frames Homecoming as a traditional week of events culminating in a football game.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson Student Activities describes Homecoming as a traditional week full of events that culminates in the homecoming football game.
cards.access_notes: Homecoming dates and individual events vary annually; confirm them through TU’s current event listings.

cards.title: Mark spring with TigerFest
cards.subtitle: Campus Activities Board signature celebration
cards.notes: Watch for the Campus Activities Board’s TigerFest Week schedule and choose an activity or concert event that matches the current program.
cards.short_summary: TigerFest evolved from Towson’s Springfest and now culminates in a CAB-sponsored concert.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson archives traces Springfest’s 1974 origins and says it was rebranded TigerFest by 1988; CAB now sponsors a week of activities culminating in a concert.
cards.access_notes: The program and concert lineup change each year; check TU’s current events calendar.

cards.title: Plan a Family Weekend visit
cards.subtitle: Campuswide annual signature event
cards.notes: Coordinate with family or supporters early, then use the published schedule to select campus activities and allow time for changing locations.
cards.short_summary: Family Weekend is one of Towson’s named campuswide Signature Events.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson lists Family Weekend among its campuswide Signature Events and says these large-scale celebrations occur annually over several days.
cards.access_notes: Dates, activities and any registration requirements vary by year; verify the current schedule.

cards.title: Send a hug to Doc
cards.subtitle: Annual Student Foundation fundraising event
cards.notes: Look for Doc Hug-A-Thon near Valentine’s Day and participate through the posted Student Foundation activity details if the event returns.
cards.short_summary: The Student Foundation includes Doc Hug-A-Thon in its recurring student giving campaign events.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson’s Student Foundation lists Doc Hug-a-Thon among its fundraising events and says those events build pride and tradition among students.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 campus report documented the annual event in February; check current Student Foundation announcements before attending.

cards.title: Add Paws for Thanks to the giving calendar
cards.subtitle: Student Foundation fundraising event
cards.notes: Check Student Foundation announcements for the next Paws for Thanks activity and follow the event’s stated participation options and donation guidance.
cards.short_summary: Paws for Thanks is a named event in Towson’s student giving campaign.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson’s Student Foundation lists Paws for Thanks among the fundraising events it oversees as part of the annual student giving campaign.
cards.access_notes: Participation format and timing are not fixed on the cited page; verify the current event announcement.

cards.title: Watch for the Great Pumpkin Smash
cards.subtitle: Student Foundation fall fundraising event
cards.notes: Check Student Foundation communications in the fall for the current Great Pumpkin Smash format, location and ways to take part responsibly.
cards.short_summary: The Great Pumpkin Smash is part of Towson’s Student Foundation fundraising-event lineup.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson’s Student Foundation lists The Great Pumpkin Smash among the fundraising events it oversees as part of the annual student giving campaign.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current date, location and participation instructions with Student Foundation before going.

cards.title: Take Towson’s issues to Annapolis
cards.subtitle: Annual SGA-led advocacy tradition
cards.notes: If Tiger Pride Day is scheduled, review the Student Government Association’s agenda and registration guidance before joining advocacy meetings with legislators.
cards.short_summary: Tiger Pride Day is Towson’s recurring campus-community advocacy day with Maryland lawmakers.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson describes Tiger Pride Day as an annual university tradition led by SGA in which campus community members meet Maryland state lawmakers.
cards.source_title: Tiger Pride Day goes virtual | Towson University
cards.access_notes: The cited event shifted online in 2021; current format, travel and registration requirements must be confirmed with SGA.

cards.title: Attend SASA’s mock shaadi
cards.subtitle: Annual South Asian Student Association signature event
cards.notes: Watch South Asian Student Association announcements for ticketing or RSVP details, then join the performances, dancing and cultural celebration with respect.
cards.short_summary: SASA’s annual mock wedding brings South Asian wedding music, dance, dress and food to a Towson audience.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson describes My Big Fat Desi Wedding as an annual mock shaadi and the South Asian Student Association’s signature event, open to all Tigers.
cards.source_title: How students brought the joy of a South Asian wedding to TU | Towson University
cards.access_notes: The 2026 edition sold out; attendance procedures and availability can change, so consult the current SASA event listing.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Towson University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-stakes first-weekend circuit: orient yourself, find study and arts spaces, get outdoors, and save campus activities for later in the day.

cards.title: Begin at the Tiger Statue
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Tiger Plaza
cards.notes: Meet your group by the bronze tiger, take an orientation photo, and notice the University Union entrances before choosing your next stop.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable opening landmark and a documented TU new-student tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson identifies the bronze tiger statue in Tiger Plaza and documents students rubbing its ear as a TU tradition.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza; observe any event setup or temporary access directions.

cards.title: Get your bearings in the Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Campus hub
cards.notes: Use the Information Desk for a first answer, then scan the posted programming and student-services locations before heading across campus.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for co-curricular activity, programs, and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson describes the University Union as the hub of co-curricular activities and programs and lists an Information Desk for visitors.
cards.access_notes: The building lists varying daily hours; check the official page before a visit.

cards.title: Locate your library base
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Academic Commons
cards.notes: Walk through the main floor, identify a study spot, and note the Academic Commons services so they are easier to find when classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A central campus library with study spaces, research help, and Academic Commons services.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson identifies Cook Library as a central place for research assistance, study spaces, and access to books, journals, and media resources.
cards.source_title: Albert S. Cook Library | Towson University Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by term; current TU affiliates may access designated 24/7 spaces after staffed hours with a OneCard.

cards.title: Make a gallery pause
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition listing, then take a short look through the gallery before deciding whether another arts event fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A public gallery in Towson’s Center for the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson states that the Center for the Arts Gallery, on the building’s third floor, is open to the public and showcases artwork.
cards.access_notes: Confirm exhibition dates and gallery hours on the arts calendar before going.

cards.title: Take the Sculpture Walk
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · Begins at Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Start at the Center for the Arts and use the official tour to turn the walk between campus buildings into a self-guided art stop.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor public-art route connecting works around campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson describes the Sculpture Walk as part of its public art collection and directs visitors to begin at the Center for the Arts.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor route; use the official tour and allow for weather or temporary construction changes.

cards.title: Walk the International Walkway
cards.subtitle: Friday early evening · Outdoor campus feature
cards.notes: Slow down along the illuminated flagpoles and use the walkway as a natural transition between the arts area and the rest of campus.
cards.short_summary: A named campus walkway displaying flags representing students’ home countries.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson says the International Walkway features illuminated flagpoles flying flags representing the home countries of students attending TU.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor feature; use normal campus pedestrian routes and follow any posted access notices.

cards.title: Make a daylight Glen walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Glen Drive
cards.notes: Enter from the Glen Towers bridge or Science Complex, follow the marked path, and leave time to look for Maryland-native trees.
cards.short_summary: A 10-acre wooded campus resource for quiet observation and scientific exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson describes the Glen Arboretum as 10 acres of woods used for quiet repose and scientific exploration.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to daylight hours. Official directions list entrances beneath the Glen Towers bridge and from the Science Complex.

cards.title: Try a Campus Rec space
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Burdick Hall
cards.notes: Bring your TU OneCard, ask staff which areas are open, and choose a low-commitment workout, swim, or walk-through of the facility.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility with fitness equipment, a pool, studios, and courts.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson states that TU students have free access to Campus Recreation facilities, including fitness, gymnasium, pool, outdoor-adventure, and turf-field spaces.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation | Towson University Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: A physical OneCard or TU Campus Rec app barcode is required for member entry; check facility hours before leaving.

cards.title: Find the clock tower
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · Historic campus core
cards.notes: Use the clock tower as a visual landmark, take a campus photo, and open the official map to connect Stephens Hall with your next destination.
cards.short_summary: Towson’s original administration building, recognizable by its clock tower.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson states that Stephens Hall, identified by its clock tower, was constructed in 1912 and originally served as the Administration Building.
cards.access_notes: Use the official interactive campus map for current walking directions and accessibility information.

cards.title: Check the arena calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Auburn Drive
cards.notes: Stop by the arena exterior, then check the official events calendar for a future game, concert, fair, or campus program that fits your plans.
cards.short_summary: A 5,200-seat campus venue used for Tiger athletics and other events.
cards.evidence_claim: Towson identifies SECU Arena as a 5,200-seat venue for athletics, sporting events, concerts, commencements, and more.
cards.access_notes: Entry and ticket requirements depend on the individual event; review the official arena calendar before attending.
